historical_record.description: A motel (The Mission Inn) stood at 5630 Mission Street.

The City Planning Commission approved, as amended, the conditional use authorization to install six panel antennas and one GPS antenna on the rooftop of the motel (The Mission Inn) at 5630 Mission Street.
